description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It initializes the ReactDOM root, renders the main App component wrapped in React.StrictMode, and includes a development diagnostic warning if the router context appears to be missing.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM element identified by 'root'.

methods.name: setTimeout
